:::{#def-inner-product-positivity}
#### Positivity

A function $\iprod{\cdot}{\cdot}$
that assigns a [real number](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers) to each ordered pair of vectors in $\reals^p$
has **positivity** if

$$
\iprod{\vx}{\vx} \ge 0
$$

[for all](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/proof-writing.html#def-universal-quantifier) $\vx \in \reals^p$.

:::
